lessons: Premise holds: clutch/journalcache.py:141 open_journal_cache mkdirs <state_dir>/cache, creates journal.duckdb.lock and loads journal.duckdb. observe.snapshot reaches it via journal_facts (clutch/observe.py:779), which conflicts with Definition of rejected 'no tool mutates lockfiles'.

clutch_snapshot (tool 1) and drafts resolution in ask.resolve_prompt (draft_stems built from observe.snapshot rows, as in clutch/__main__.py:1607) both need snapshot. So the ticket requires a call that its own rejection rule forbids, and no in-fence code can fix this.

Re-author with one fix: either state that the derived journal cache and its lock under <state_dir>/cache are allowed writes for read tools, or fence clutch/observe.py and clutch/journalcache.py plus their tests and specify a read-only snapshot path.

Class prevention: a ticket that declares a tool or verb 'read-only' should name which derived caches it may write, such as state_dir/cache/journal.duckdb. Author review should check every required call path against that list.
